say: Your plan failed. Ask AI why. Step three stops it!
Most plans fail for reasons you could have seen coming. AI is good at imagining the failure before it happens.
First, tell AI your plan in three sentences, and say it is a year from now and the plan failed. That's the setup.
Next, ask for the five most likely reasons it failed, ranked from most to least likely.
Now the step that stops it. Ask what one change this week would stop the biggest reason.
AI guesses, so treat the list as questions to check, not facts.
